aistandardsio/agent-protocols.name: Agent Protocols
aistandardsio/agent-protocols.description: Go implementations of agent authentication and authorization protocols. Includes core protocol packages, identity provider adapters, cross-protocol bridge, and working examples.

aistandardsio/oaiaf.name: Open Agent Internet Architecture Framework
aistandardsio/oaiaf.description: Reference architecture for building AI agents with built-in support for ID-JAG, AAuth, AIMS, A2A, AuthZEN, and MCP. Provides the five-layer agent identity stack model.
